convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'BnB' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh and SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) that provide trading functions and smoothing algorithms not available in standard Python libraries.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timing
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before indicator is valid

other_exits: Signal-based close: BUY_Close triggered when indicator line crosses below signal line (opposite of entry); SELL_Close triggered when indicator line crosses above signal line

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses

custom_logic_notes: Signal detection uses 2-bar lookback: compares bar[1] vs bar[0] (relative to SignalBar offset). When Ind[1]>Sign[1] (indicator was above signal on prior bar) AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (indicator crossed to or below signal on current bar), a BUY open and SELL close are triggered. Vice versa for SELL. The SignalBar input (default=1) offsets which bar is treated as 'current' for signal reading. When SignalBar=0, the EA recalculates on every tick instead of only on new bars. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean gates that can independently enable/disable long entry, short entry, long close, and short close respectively.
python_conversion_notes: The BnB custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It requires the T3 smoothing algorithm (and potentially other methods from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh: JJMA, JurX, ParMA, VIDYA, AMA). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, and GlobalVariableDel_ functions which handle order placement, position sizing (5 margin modes), and cleanup - these must be reimplemented. Position sizing logic with 5 margin modes (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) adds complexity. The crossover logic comparing Ind vs Sign buffers across 2 bars is straightforward to replicate. SL/TP are passed as integer pips to the trading functions - verify whether the TradeAlgorithms.mqh internally handles digit adjustment (likely yes since the EA passes raw values).
